description: Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Abwasseranlagen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The dataset contains the public wastewater treatment plant (sections and nodes) of the city of Gelsenkirchen. In addition to the spatial location, further factual information (type of wastewater, building materials, diameter and gradient) is kept. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Gelsenkirchen: Waste water treatment plants" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Schächte, Abwasser, Entwässerung, Sinkkästen, Kanalisation, Haltungen. The listing shows 2019-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
